title: An AI-generated Rumpelstiltskin meme is freaking out much of the internet
key_facts: An AI-generated clip shows a creepy imp who turns straw into gold coins for a frightened woman, and it looks like it came from an old film.
The clip was first posted online in August by a self-described AI artist and filmmaker.
Over the past week users set the clip to a rap song and turned it into a meme, swapping in other characters for the imp.
One early post, paired with a caption, got more than 900,000 views on TikTok in less than a week.
A TikTok account that reposts variations of the meme passed 65,000 followers within a few days.
It took days before many viewers realised the clip was AI-generated, and users cared little about that once it went viral.
quote_evidence: Now, AI has spun the fairy-tale character into an eerie internet meme.
It took days before viewers began realizing it was simply AI-generated.
It racked up more than 900,000 views on TikTok in less than a week.
why_it_matters_hint: AI-made video can spread as entertainment even after people learn it is AI-made.
event_date: Clip posted August 2026; the meme spread over the week before 7 Oct 2026.
